name: Primitive Combo Puzzle
description: A grab-and-stack version of the primitive assembler, descended from balance_puzzle: a target 'sign combo' (● + ▲ + ▮) is posed, and a tray of FREE, grabbable physics primitives is dealt. The player picks them up and stacks them on the plinth in the right order; match the sequence and hold it steady, and the round is solved — then a fresh combo is dealt. Order under gravity: a stack is a sequence you must also keep standing.
theoreticalGrounding: Composition is precarious. A stack is not a set — order is content — and under gravity that order must also balance. The puzzle hands the assembler's '+' to the player's hands and asks them to compose the grammar physically; the reward is a tower that stands.

primitive_combo_puzzle.name: Primitive Combo Puzzle
primitive_combo_puzzle.description: Goal plinth with the sign combo placard + a translucent ghost of the target stack; a low tray that deals real grabbable XRToolsPickable primitives (sphere/cube/cylinder/cone/disc) around its rim; a glowing centre ring marking the stacking column. Grab the pieces and stack them bottom-to-top in the target order; when the central column's shapes match and settle (stability_time), the combo solves with a ring-pulse celebration, then a new one is dealt. Reuses the DNA alphabet from primitive_stack and the project's grab_* pickables.
primitive_combo_puzzle.qfep_connection: F_order: sequence as content — the player composes an ordered combo and the machine confirms the grammar.
